      "note": "objected that resubmitting to mempool leaks transactions, then ACKed the updates and supported backporting"
    },

      "login": "fanquake",

      "note": "pinged reviewers"
    },

      "login": "w0xlt",

    },
    {
      "login": "vasild",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept NACKed; objected that the change cripples wallet rebroadcast over an unrelated feature"
    },
    {
      "login": "polespinasa",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "tended to Concept NACK; objected to disabling useful rebroadcast functionality rather than fixing dust resubmission generally"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5822665076",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Questioned whether resubmit should differ from CommitTransaction, which does not use private broadcast",
      "quote": "The current behavior is that all transactions being sent via the wallet do not use private broadcast at all; `CommitTransaction` uses `MEMPOOL_AND_BROADCAST_TO_ALL`, and it follows that resubmit behav",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "andrewtoth explained that it protects against rebroadcast of transactions originating outside the wallet (sendrawtransaction, watch-only, dust)",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5823087651"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5823087651",
      "status_by_quote": "This is true, but the case this change is protecting against is transactions sent by other means that also belong to the"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4099089685",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Resubmitting transactions to the mempool still trivially reveals them to an active observer under -privatebroadcast",
      "quote": "IMO should return here without ever being resubmitted to the mempool since learning a peer's mempool is trivial for an active observer.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author agreed and pushed an update to never resubmit when pb is set",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4105713757",
        "rc:4106693516"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4106693516",
      "status_by_quote": "pushed an update so the wallet never resubmits when pb is set. Avoids restarts and loading wallets triggering it"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5834307893",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Asked whether the change is intended for backport, noting that full wallet private broadcast would be preferable if not backporting",
      "quote": "Is this intended for backport?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that backporting makes sense since full wallet integration is not close to done",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5836147841"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5836147841",
      "status_by_quote": "Given that wallet integration isn't close to done, I think we should remove footguns until we get there. This is easily "
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4115855286",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Use -persistmempool=0 instead of -mempoolexpiry=1 in wallet_resendwallettransactions.py to make the test more concise with identical coverage",
      "quote": "I think we can use `-persistmempool=0` here instead of `-mempoolexpiry=1` to make this more concise with identical coverage",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted the test suggestion in an update",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4123678855"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4123678855",
      "status_by_quote": "largely took, thanks"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5887071448",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Tying wallet rebroadcast to -privatebroadcast contradicts documentation that -privatebroadcast does not affect the wallet and prevents having both -privatebroadcast and wallet rebroadcast",
      "quote": "It adds a relationship between wallet behavior and `-privatebroadcast`. It is documented that `-privatebroadcast` does not affect the wallet.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "vasild pushed back against parameter interactions between -privatebroadcast and wallet settings",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5890683539"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5907108581",
      "status_by_quote": "I just don't like those parameter interactions - in general, they could be hard to reason about."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6074151790",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Disabling wallet rebroadcast cripples the wallet due to an unrelated feature being enabled, whereas users sending via RPC should use -walletbroadcast=0",
      "quote": "The wallet rebroadcast is and has always been bad for privacy, but it has its use cases. This PR would cripple the wallet due to an unrelated feature being enabled.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that feature interactions exist and disabling footguns is better than relying on docs",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6081186947"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6081186947",
      "status_by_quote": "Interactions between features exist and should not be ignored. It's a wallet issue, for sure, but for a wallet + pb user, it would be extremely surprising."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6084798078",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Disabling rebroadcast is the wrong solution as it removes a useful feature, whereas the dust-resubmit privacy attack affects standard broadcast too and should be fixed generally or limited to mempool evictions",
      "quote": "I don't feel disabling a useful feature such as rebroadcast is the right step here.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
